options.name: ignore_scripts
options.description: Use the C(--ignore-scripts) flag when installing.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of a Node.js library to install. If omitted all packages in package.json are installed. To globally install from local Node.js library. Prepend C(file:) to the path of the Node.js library.

options.name: path
options.description: The base path where Node.js installs libraries. This is where the C(node_modules) folder lives.

options.name: production
options.description: Install dependencies in production mode. C(yarn) ignores any dependencies under devDependencies in C(package.json).

options.name: registry
options.description: The registry to install modules from.

options.name: state
options.description: Installation state of the named Node.js library. If V(absent) is selected, a O(name) option must be provided.

options.name: version
options.description: The version of the library to be installed. Must be in semver format. If "latest" is desired, use O(state) arg instead.
